LanguageData.Cultist.Quest.Expedition: Travel to the abandoned observatory, take the engraved survey plate and deliver it to a home settlement. If the site is lost, the leader can trace another one at the altar.
LanguageData.Cultist.Quest.Vigil.Title: The rite of the watchkeeper
LanguageData.Cultist.Quest.Vigil.Description: Use the altar to choose a lore book, a repaired tool and a society member as an assistant. The book and tool must together provide at least {0} power. Protect the altar and the leader for {1} hours and drive off the attackers. The rite ends when you choose what becomes of the leader.
LanguageData.Cultist.Quest.Seer.Title: An exalted disciple
LanguageData.Cultist.Quest.Seer.Description: Advance a matching disciple to exalted rank at the altar using two lore books and a society-aligned influence of at least {0}.
LanguageData.Cultist.Quest.Repair.Title: Set the mirror right
LanguageData.Cultist.Quest.Repair.Description: Use a crafting spot to repair the cracked wayfarer’s mirror with components.
LanguageData.Cultist.Quest.Transcript.Title: A trader’s transcript
LanguageData.Cultist.Quest.Transcript.Description: Study a survey transcript with any society member to recover two books of society lore.
